title: KCP assistant_revision_list result (DESIGN.md §10.5, §11.6.1 assistant author/deploy family)
description: CommandResult.result payload for assistant_revision_list (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). §11.5 page of AssistantRevision projections (gap notes KG4/KG9). §11.5 page shape verbatim: { items[], next?, snapshot, boundary_event_cursor }. The first page creates a stable snapshot token (expiry >= 15 minutes); further pages see the same logical boundary or return snapshot-expired; authorization is rechecked for every page (gap note KG9).

items.description: Page of AssistantRevision projections; at most 512 items (§11.8 page read limit).

sdk_protocol_range.description: Supported SDK protocol range; DESIGN.md pins no range grammar — opaque identifier-shaped expression (gap note KG8).

signature_refs.description: signature_refs[] verbatim from the §10.5 record shape; may be empty. At most 256 list items per request (§11.8).

assistantRevision.description: Immutable AssistantRevision projection, field names verbatim from the §10.5 record shape. Configuration secrets are represented only by broker-owned references and are excluded from the portable revision (§10.5).

cursor.description: Opaque, authenticated cursor or snapshot token (§11.3, §11.5); the 4096-char ceiling is the K0 cursor-cap extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md item 9).

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 value of a §11.8 typed digest; the digest type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it (§11.8: a bare 32-byte value cannot be substituted across digest fields).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

runtime.description: "runtime + locked dependency metadata" (§14.2 prose line): open object pending a packaging-format freeze (gap note KG7). Carries no authority.

supported_worker_protocols.description: Worker protocol versions the package supports (§14.2). At most 256 list items per request (§11.8).

skills.description: Skills advertise routing suitability; they never grant permission (§14.2). At most 256 list items per request (§11.8).

items.description: Inert attention declaration (§14.2): deployment may activate one only after deterministic validation and an exact acceptance or standing-policy use. Typed shape lands with attention_coordination_v1 (K2) — gap note KG7.

attention_proposals.description: Inert proposals; packages never select raw subjects or install their own wake authority (§14.2).

requested_capabilities.description: Requested capability names (§14.2); requesting never grants. At most 256 list items per request (§11.8).

model_profiles.description: Named model broker profiles the package requests (§14.2). At most 256 list items per request (§11.8).

tool_profiles.description: Named tool profiles the package requests (§14.2). At most 256 list items per request (§11.8).

network_policy.description: Declared network policy (§14.2): open object pending secure_effects_v1 (K4) — gap note KG7. Enforcement evidence comes from the supervisor boundary, never this declaration (§14.4).

default_timeout.description: Default timeout; DESIGN.md pins no unit (gap note KG7).

security_profiles.description: Profiles the package is compatible with — an eligibility hint only; enforcement evidence comes from the trusted supervisor (§14.4).

manifest.description: Validated assistant-revision manifest: the §14.2 field list verbatim, typed per gap note KG7 ("runtime + locked dependency metadata" → runtime; causal_concurrency_policy from the §15.3 closed policy set; security_profiles from §14.4).

resourceLimits.description: resource_limits {cpu, memory, disk, output_bytes} verbatim from the §14.2 manifest list; DESIGN.md pins no units — safe non-negative integers, units recorded as unpinned (gap note KG7).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).
